digest.en: Paraguay and Taiwan reaffirm ties after China sought to lure away another Taipei ally. European countries emerge as NATO leaders as U.S. role recedes. World food prices rise for a third straight month, according to the U.N.
digest.hi: तमिलनाडु के राज्यपाल पर सवाल उठ रहे हैं। डॉक्टरों की कमी के बीच ट्रंप प्रशासन ने आव्रजन आवेदनों पर लगी रोक हटाई।

articles.title: Paraguay and Taiwan reaffirm ties after China sought to lure away another Taipei ally
articles.summary: Paraguay and Taiwan reaffirmed their diplomatic ties after China attempted to lure Paraguay away from Taipei. The two countries' relationship was tested by China's efforts to expand its influence in the region. Paraguay chose to maintain its alliance with Taiwan.

articles.title: European countries emerge as NATO leaders as U.S. role recedes
articles.summary: European countries are taking on more leadership roles in NATO as the US role appears to be diminishing. This shift in dynamics comes after President Trump's decision to launch strikes on Iran without fully consulting NATO allies. Tensions within the alliance have increased.

articles.title: World Food Prices Rise for Third Straight Month, U.N. Says
articles.summary: The United Nations reported that world food prices have risen for the third consecutive month. The increase is a concern for global food security. The UN tracks food prices to monitor trends and potential impacts on vulnerable populations.

articles.title: As war on Ukraine continues, Russia prepares for smaller Victory Day parade
articles.summary: Russia is preparing for a smaller Victory Day parade as the war in Ukraine continues to have an impact. The annual parade is typically a grand display of Russia's military strength. This year's event will be more subdued.

articles.title: More than 120 defense officials and experts converge in Beijing to tackle security challenges
articles.summary: Over 120 defense officials and experts gathered in Beijing to discuss security challenges. The meeting focused on global security governance and tackling pressing issues. The event brought together a large group of international participants to share perspectives and ideas.

articles.title: Some people in Iran have kept internet access despite government-imposed blackout
articles.summary: Iranian authorities have allowed a small group of people to maintain internet access despite a nationwide blackout, reportedly granting them "white internet" status. The move is unusual and unclear in its motivations.

articles.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
articles.summary: Oil prices rose after US and Iranian forces exchanged fire in the Hormuz strait. The incident occurred despite US President Donald Trump's claim that a ceasefire between the two countries remains in place. The exact circumstances of the exchange are unclear.

articles.title: Global tracing operations underway after outbreak on luxury cruise ship
articles.summary: Global health authorities are tracing the source of an outbreak on a luxury cruise ship. The investigation is ongoing, with multiple countries involved in the effort to contain the spread of the disease.

articles.title: Report on Honduras 'reassessing ties, agreements with China' is distorted, inconsistent with facts
articles.summary: Honduras has denied reports that it is reassessing ties with China, contradicting a statement made by the Chinese Foreign Ministry. The statement was described as distorted and inconsistent with facts.

articles.title: South Africa's top court rules against president over 'Farmgate' scandal
articles.summary: South Africa's top court has ruled against President Cyril Ramaphosa in the "Farmgate" scandal, finding him in breach of the law. The decision is a significant setback for the president.

articles.title: India pushes for inclusive migration, stronger anti-trafficking laws at United Nations General
articles.summary: India's Kirti Singh pushed for inclusive migration and anti-trafficking laws at the United Nations. Kirti Singh highlighted the various extensive initiatives undertaken by India, including the use of digital technologies, to support its nationals abroad.

articles.title: Ceasefire on brink as Tehran launches fresh strikes on UAE
articles.summary: Trump claimed a ceasefire is still in place despite the US and Iran trading strikes. Iran war live: Trump says ceasefire still in place despite trading strikes in Hormuz The Independent.

articles.title: Musk Once Slammed Anthropic As A Threat to Civilisation. Now He Powers It
articles.summary: Elon Musk has become the landlord of Anthropic, a company he previously criticized as a threat to civilization. The move marks a change in Musk's stance on the company. Elon Musk is officially the landlord for Anthropic (File Photo).

articles.title: ASEAN leaders meet to discuss plans to ease Iran war impacts
articles.summary: Southeast Asian leaders met in the Philippines to discuss the economic impact of the Iran war. They also addressed disputes in the South China Sea and border clashes between Thailand and Cambodia.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine Continue Fighting Despite Putin’s World War Two Ceasefire Proposal
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine continued fighting despite a ceasefire proposal by Putin on World War Two anniversary. The proposal did not halt the conflict between the two nations. Russia and Ukraine Continue Fighting Despite Putin’s World War Two Ceasefire Proposal Modern Diplomacy.

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine trade fire, blame despite Victory Day ceasefire
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine exchanged fire and blamed each other for violations. Attacks continued across front lines despite a declared ceasefire on Victory Day. Warring sides accuse each other of violations as attacks continue across front lines.

articles.title: Ceasefire holds despite Iran, US blows; Israel hits Lebanon
articles.summary: A ceasefire held despite recent strikes by Iran and the US. Israel conducted a hit in Lebanon amid the ongoing conflict. Iran war live: Ceasefire holds despite Iran, US blows; Israel hits Lebanon Al Jazeera.

articles.title: Amid Ukraine’s daring assaults, Russia scales back Victory Day celebrations
articles.summary: Russia scaled back Victory Day celebrations due to Ukraine's assaults. The event on May 9 will have less military showcasing than usual. An important date in the Russian calendar, May 9 will be a slimmed-down affair with less military showcasing.

articles.title: Around 200 foreigners detained over suspected online scam operation, say Batam authorities
articles.summary: Indonesian authorities detained around 200 foreigners, mostly Chinese nationals, for suspected involvement in online scams. The detainees, also including individuals from the Philippines and Vietnam, were reportedly involved in romance scams and phishing schemes.

articles.title: Trump says ceasefire remains after US and Iran exchange fire
articles.summary: US President Trump stated that a ceasefire remains in place after a recent exchange of fire between the US and Iran. The statement comes amid ongoing tensions between the two countries, with Trump asserting the ceasefire's status.

articles.title: Southeast Asia’s leaders confront fallout from Iran war at ASEAN summit
articles.summary: ASEAN leaders will call for energy cooperation and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Bloc is expected to call for deeper energy cooperation and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Southeast Asia’s leaders confront fallout from Iran war at ASEAN summit.
